europe_now.summary: France has experienced widespread demonstrations resulting in over a thousand arrests and significant security deployments in major cities. Far-right leader Marine Le Pen launched her presidential campaign by attempting to leverage the ongoing unrest.

europe_now.title: Historic Electoral Defeat in Serbia
europe_now.summary: Longtime Serbian leader Aleksandar Vučić has conceded defeat following snap parliamentary elections marked by record-high voter turnout. The outcome followed intense public mobilization and student-led protest movements in the country.
